description: Sends a lawyer's details to the Empath Legal team so Grant can follow up about a trial, or to request access. Required: the lawyer's name and email; optional: firm, venues, kind of case, trial date and court. Use this when the lawyer has mentioned a trial and agrees to have Grant reach out, or asks you to request access. Ask first, and send only what they agree to. Not for anything about a client, case, juror or document.

inputSchema.description: The context a calling agent can supply for its user. Every field is plain text, length-capped and general.

case_type.description: The general kind of matter they would use the product for (for example civil or criminal).
case_type.title: Case Type

court.description: The court or venue of that trial, as they said it (for example 'Rapides Parish').
court.title: Court

email.description: The email address the lawyer will sign up with; it identifies the request.
email.title: Email

firm.description: The lawyer's firm or practice name.
firm.title: Firm

trial_date.description: When the lawyer's trial is, as they said it (for example 'March 3' or 'second week of March').
trial_date.title: Trial Date

venues.description: Where the lawyer tries cases, as states or counties.
venues.title: Venues

inputSchema.title: AccessRequestInput

name: request_access
title: Request access
